body.x: GOYANG, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2006') -- <Visual News> PLK showcased a driving recorder ''RoadBox''. It automatically senses accidents and record real-time screen of 14 seconds before and 6 seconds after the crush. Synchronous recording of acceleration speed data is provided. You can also record anytime by pressing REC button on the back of the camera.

< AVING Special Report Team for ''KES 2006'': Publisher & Editor, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Caleb Ma, Jason Lee, Gaius Park, Phoebe Kwon, Sheri Choi, Joshua Shim, Daniel Sirh, Rose Kim, Paul Kim, Samuel Kim, Abe Shim, Grace Won >
